description.value: Diamond Sweets & Restaurant is a multi-location Indian food chain operating across Surrey and Delta, BC, rooted in traditional South Asian recipes, house-made spice blends, and scratch-prepared Indian sweets. The menu spans over 100 items covering tandoori specialties, seafood, lamb, and a broad range of vegetarian dishes, making it a substantial refuelling stop for hungry riders. Catering is also offered throughout Metro Vancouver for events ranging from weddings to corporate gatherings.
